metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for `lmd` (let-me-do). Add via `claude plugin marketplace add <github-user>/let-me-do`, then install with `claude plugin install lmd@let-me-do`.

plugins.name: lmd
plugins.description: Autopilot pipeline (scouter → code-planner ⇄ plan-reviewer → developer ⇄ tester → reviewer ⇄ developer → committer) that drives one task from intake to commit. Agent-to-agent context flows through files under `.lmd/autopilot/`; the main agent holds only short status payloads. Tester does both static analysis and runtime Playwright UI verification. Backed by `brain`, a Postgres graph + task store shared across sessions.
